messages:
anya: heads up — proposal to split route_metrics into a lightweight materialized view + compact table for per-route hourly aggregates. reduces read join pressure for the console. RFC: https://go/rfcs/routeview-split (short tl;dr below)

ben: is this mostly for dashboard perf or also to shrink ingest cost?

anya: both. dashboards query a bunch of heavy joins on raw_events. idea is: keep raw_events as source of truth, dual-write an hourly_compact table and materialize a route_view_mv for console reads. cuts p99 reads, cheaper indexes.

mike: dual-write raises consistency questions. what about backfill and replays?

anya: plan: 1) dual-write from ingest service behind a flag, 2) run backfill job that consumes raw_events via consumer group and populates hourly_compact, 3) enable read path canary to route 5% of console queries to route_view_mv, 4) monitor diffs and promote.

sophia: what metrics are we watching for the canary? error rate, mismatch rate, p99 latency, and cost delta?

anya: exactly. add a new pipeline:
```
- mismatch_rate = rows_different / rows_sampled
- p99_console_latency
- index_read_iops
- per-route_cardinality_change
```

nate: sample size for mismatch checks? need to be statistically meaningful across low-traffic routes too.

anya: we'll stratify: big routes (top 5% traffic) use large sample, tail routes use deterministic checksum per hour. fallback if mismatch > 0.1% for big routes or any mismatch for tail routes.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: feature-flag "routeview_dualwrite" -> staging -> canary group a (5%)

ben: rolling back dual-write is expensive if partial. can we make the dual-write idempotent + idempotency key = (route_id, hour, write_version)?

mike: yes, use upsert on (route_id, hour) with write_version monotonic. keep write_version in headers so backfills can stamp correct version.

anya: good. also adding a visibility flag in hourly_compact.rows indicating source_version and last_seen. simplifies reconciliation.

sophia: how about read fallback? if route_view_mv misses a row, console should query raw_events fallback synchronously? that could spike latency.

anya: fallback flow: try route_view_mv, if miss then async-refresh and show stale indicator in UI for that route. only sync-refetch for critical console pages (billing/quotas).

nate: backfill window? we have 60 days of raw_events retention in hot storage. backfill should operate within that window; long-tail customers might need longer — add a ticket for ops to extend retention for specific tenants during backfill.

ben: what about schema evolution: hourly_compact will have route_tags and quota_profile columns. need migration hooks in ingest service.

anya: ingest schema change will be opt-in behind flag. migration steps in RFC include sample psql DDL:
```
CREATE TABLE hourly_compact (
  route_id text,
  hour timestamptz,
  requests bigint,
  errors bigint,
  quota_profile text,
  route_tags jsonb,
  source_version int,
  last_seen timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY (route_id, hour)
);
```

mike: consider partitioning by hour range to prune older data cheaply.

anya: yeah partition by range (hour) monthly. backfill job writes into appropriate partition.

sophia: dashboards need a migration plan: add new datasource and feature-flag the console card to query hourly_compact for the canary group only. ops: how to switch all routes?

anya: rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automated checks at each step and manual gate for quota-affecting pages.

nate: alerting: create alerts for mismatch_rate > threshold, p99 regression > 20%, and backfill lag > 1h for > 5% partitions.

ben: are we logging diffs to kafka topic for later replay? would help debugging.

anya: yes, diffs emitted to telemetry-sanity topic with compact schema (route_id,hour,delta_summary). retention 7d.

mike: ops runbook please: how to force re-sync a single route?

anya: runbackfill job: `./backfill --route $ROUTE --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-07` or force upsert via admin UI. document includes safety checks.

sophia: cool. can we add a field to tag rows that are "canary_verified" once reconciled? helps queries until fully promoted.

anya: done. will update RFC and create the migration PR for hourly_compact DDL + ingest flag.

ben: thumbs up. please add a note about quota recalculation — we must ensure billing jobs use hourly_compact only after full promotion.

anya: noted. will add migration step: switch billing consumer to hourly_compact only after 100% promotion and a 48h verification window.

deploy-bot: canary deployment complete: feature-flag "routeview_dualwrite" enabled for group a. monitoring hooks: https://go/mon/routeview-canary

mike: i'll pair with ops tomorrow for the backfill run. thanks all. :rocket:
